programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The “Adriatic Highway” is one of the most beautiful coastal roads in the world. The “technical masterwork” was built in the 1950s and 60s, at the time of Yugoslavian President Tito. Abounding in curves, the asphalt road stretches from Ankaran in Slovenia to Ulcinj in Montenegro. More than half of the road is in Croatia (659 km) and a quarter in Montenegro (125 km). Shorter segments lead through Slovenia; only nine kilometers are in Bosnia and Herzegovina. For all four countries of the former Yugoslavian Federation, the 1,200-kilometer-long highway remains the main thoroughfare of Adriatic tourism. For many travelers, the highway is the absolute dream road. In dizzying heights, it hugs the steep cliffs lining the Adriatic Sea, winds through coves and bays, gardens and stony fields. Wonderful views of the blue sea, green islands, bizarre cliffs and Mediterranean cities and towns are typical of the highway. But with its numerous curves, the dream road also harbors many dangers.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The “Adriatic Highway” is one of the most beautiful coastal roads in the world. The “technical masterwork” was built in the 1950s and 60s, at the time of Yugoslavian President Tito. Abounding in curves, the asphalt road stretches from Ankaran in Slovenia to Ulcinj in Montenegro. More than half of the road is in Croatia (659 km) and a quarter in Montenegro (125 km). Shorter segments lead through Slovenia; only nine kilometers are in Bosnia and Herzegovina. For all four countries of the former Yugoslavian Federation, the 1,200-kilometer-long highway remains the main thoroughfare of Adriatic tourism. For many travelers, the highway is the absolute dream road. In dizzying heights, it hugs the steep cliffs lining the Adriatic Sea, winds through coves and bays, gardens and stony fields. Wonderful views of the blue sea, green islands, bizarre cliffs and Mediterranean cities and towns are typical of the highway. But with its numerous curves, the dream road also harbors many dangers.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The air wants to flee the heat, but is too weak. It hovers just above the ground, heavy and weighed down by the oven-like heat. It turns wanly around itself, and tries to cool off by liquefying itself. It vibrates, it oscillates – but there is no escape. This is West Africa in late March. The Harmattan, the hot desert wind of the Sahara, is blowing without respite. It has no pity with the people who live here. Whoever wants to go from one place to another has to travel on roads that hardly deserve this name. They are dusty paths that don’t appear on any map. They are maneuverable only with great effort and for a few months of the year. They are impassable during the rainy season, since they are washed over by the Niger River, one of the mightiest rivers in the world. When it starts to rain, the roads turn into muddy paths. Every journey is a trip into uncertainty.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: They run through deserts, through ice and snow, deep into the jungle, along the water and over the mountains. The landscapes through which these routes wind are unique and exert their never-ending fascination even on regular travellers. In our documentary “Hot Roads – An Icebound Road” which is part of the five-part film series “Hot Roads” we want to tell the stories that take place along the route itself, of the people who live along it and for whom the road is part and parcel of their personal destiny.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Tanzania-Zambia-Railway (Tazara) is one of Africa's most ambitious infrastructure projects. It connects the inland with the coast of East Africa and meant independence from the surrounding apartheid-ruled countries of East Africa. The film accompanies the Tazara on its 52-hour journey through Tanzania and Zambia and uses spectacular aerial shots to show not only the architectural monuments but also the unknown sides of the previously hidden landscapes of Tanzania and Zambia.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Ferrocarril del Sur, one of the highest train routes on earth, runs right through the mountains of Peru. To this day, it is considered a miracle in the world of railways. The rails not only lead to the famous ruined city of Machu Picchu but connect the ancient Inca capital of Cusco with Puno on the shores of Lake Titicaca and the gleaming white city of Arequipa. A train journey with the Andes Explorer through a grandiose landscape and an undeveloped and inaccessible area.

programme.title: UCL Extended Highlights
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.title: Berufsgeheimnisse
programme.desc: Neurochirurg Professor Vajkoczy operiert jeden Tag fünf bis zehn Patienten. Oft sind es heikle Fälle, bei denen viel auf dem Spiel steht. Bei einer Patientin ist es eine Metastase im Rückenmark. Der Chirurg muss so präzise operieren, dass das umliegende Gewebe geschont wird, sonst droht eine Querschnittlähmung...

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: New York ist seit langem als eine der rattenreichsten Städte in den USA bekannt. Schätzungen zufolge sollen sich hier bis zu 2 Millionen Exemplare herumtreiben. Sowohl Angestellte der Stadt als auch viele Einwohner führen einen nicht enden wollenden Kampf gegen die ungeliebten und sehr anpassungsfähigen Nagetiere.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Das gelbe Taxi ist der Inbegriff des New Yorker Stadtverkehrs. Was vor fast hundert Jahren mit einer kleinen Flotte begann, hat sich zu einem florierenden System aus tausenden von Fahrzeugen entwickelt. Doch die Bedrohung durch Apps wie Uber und ein Skandal in der Stadt haben dazu geführt, dass die Taxifahrer nun hoch verschuldet sind.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Wo viele Menschen leben, fällt auch viel Müll an. Das gilt auch für New York: Hier werden jedes Jahr über 14 Millionen Tonnen Müll produziert. Eine Kombination aus städtischen Behörden und privaten Unternehmen arbeitet täglich mit großem Einsatz daran, wegzuschaffen, was die New Yorker loswerden wollen.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Unter den legendären Straßen New Yorks befindet sich ein riesiges Netz von Rohren, die das Abwassersystem der Stadt bilden. Die New Yorker erzeugen etwa 1,3 Milliarden Liter Abwasser pro Tag, das durch insgesamt 12.000 Kilometer Rohre geleitet wird. Der Legende nach sollen in der Kanalisation sogar Alligatoren ihr Unwesen treiben.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: In New York werden jedes Jahr ungefähr zwölf Millionen Tonnen Dampf produziert. Einige der berühmtesten Gebäude der Stadt werden mit dieser alten, aber zuverlässigen Technologie beheizt. Doch das Dampfsystem liefert auch Kühlung, versorgt Kunstmuseen mit Luftfeuchtigkeit oder kommt in Restaurants bei der Reinigung zum Einsatz.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: New York City hat einige der berühmtesten Brücken der Welt, wie die Brooklyn Bridge und die George Washington Bridge. Diese technischen Wunderwerke haben einen Beitrag dazu geleistet, wie Brücken auf der ganzen Welt entworfen werden. Doch die Instandhaltung der alternden Riesen ist eine wahre Mammutaufgabe.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: New York City mag als Betondschungel bekannt sein, aber die städtischen Parks sind seit jeher ein fester Bestandteil der pulsierenden Metropole. Die sich insgesamt über 30.000 Hektar erstreckenden Grünflächen dienen den New Yorkern als Zufluchtsort. Doch auch der Stadt selbst dienen sie auf vielfältige Weise.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: New York verfügt über einen der verkehrsreichsten Lufträume der Welt. Hier werden jeden Tag 3.000 Flüge und jedes Jahr 140 Millionen Passagiere abgefertigt. Die städtischen Flughäfen sind essenzieller Bestandteil der Infrastruktur New Yorks und ermöglichen es Menschen aus der ganzen Welt, diese besondere Stadt zu besuchen.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Felix und Max sind leidenschaftliche Motorradfahrer und lieben die Geschwindigkeit. Heute wollen sie sich diesen Kick auf Borkum ganz ohne Motor geben. Mit der unberechenbaren Kraft des Windes geht es mit einem Kitebuggy über den kilometerlagen Strand. Diese Gefährte erreichen dabei bis zu 100 Kilometer die Stunde. Die beiden haben es sich allerdings leichter vorgestellt, als es tatsächlich ist.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Skiken ist eine nordische Sportart bei der man auf Skiern mit Rollen auch im Sommer die Pisten unsicher machen kann. Allerdings stand John noch nie in seinem Leben auf Skiern, geschweige denn Skikes. Kann Skike-Trainer Erik Kreutzner ihn heute wirklich von seinem Lieblingssport begeistern oder vergeht John so die komplette Lust aufs Skifahren?

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Felix und Max begeben sich auf moderne Schatzsuche. Mit Hilfe von GPS-Koordinaten gilt es "Caches" zu finden, die andere Abenteurer versteckt haben. Im Wald wollen sie einen Multicache finden. Dabei geht es darum, mehrere Verstecke aufzuspüren, um am Ende einen Bonuscache zu entdecken. Um die Aufgabe meistern zu können, beginnt die Schnitzeljagd der Schulfreunde in aller Frühe.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Felix und Max wollen dieses Mal auf das Dach Deutschlands. Ohne Vorbereitung wollen Sie den Gipfel der Zugspitze in fast 3.000 Metern Höhe erklimmen. Den Aufstieg wollen die Abenteurer in zwei Tagen schaffen, doch im hochalpinen Gelände geht ihnen langsam die Puste aus. Zudem macht Max seine Höhenangst mit jedem Meter mehr zu schaffen.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen
programme.desc: Wir besuchen die Baustelle des Albvorlandtunnels.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen
programme.desc: Ohne die einarmigen Riesen läuft auf Großbaustellen gar nichts.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen
programme.desc: Wenn der "Büffel" anrollt erzittert der Bahndamm.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen
programme.desc: Braunkohle-Förderanlagen zählen zu den größten Arbeitsmaschinen der Welt.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Wie können wir uns den Wind als mächtige Naturgewalt möglichst effizient zunutze machen? Einer der größten Windparks der Welt entsteht vor der englischen Küste, wo die rauen Bedingungen das Projekt vor große Herausforderungen stellen. Unterdessen strebt ein norwegisches Team danach, den allerersten schwimmenden Windpark zu bauen.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Es ist die größte technologische Herausforderung, der sich die Menschheit je gestellt hat: die Kernfusion. Sie könnte das Streben nach der ultimativen Energielösung ein für alle Mal beenden. Doch die Herausforderungen sind so gewaltig, dass ein stromerzeugender Fusionsreaktor bisher schwer fassbar und unerreichbar erschien - bis jetzt.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Die Art und Weise, wie wir fliegen, wird sich zweifellos ändern. Ein Wandel, der nicht von der herkömmlichen Luft- und Raumfahrtindustrie vorangetrieben wird, sondern von einer neuen Generation von Fliegern, die sich nicht scheuen, anders zu denken. Von umweltfreundlichen lokalen Flughäfen bis hin zu autonomen Flugtaxis - elektrisch betriebene Flugzeuge könnten eine Zeitenwende einleiten.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Wenn die globale Schifffahrt ein Land wäre, wäre sie der sechstgrößte Verursacher von Treibhausgasemissionen. Aber Reedereien und Ingenieure schaffen bemerkenswerte neue Maschinen, um ihre Industrie umweltfreundlicher zu machen. Dafür nutzen sie eine Ressource, die den Menschen seit Jahrtausenden über die Weltmeere bewegt: Wind.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Die erfolglose Suche nach einem sichereren Kühlmittel führt zur Erfindung von Teflon, eine beschädigte Lieferkiste zur Erfindung von Dynamit. Eine zufällige Begegnung zwischen dem Hollywoodstar Hedy Lamarr und einem Komponisten ebnet den Weg für WLAN - und Pawlows Hundeexperiment für unsere Handysucht.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Ein fehlgeschlagenes Experiment beschert uns das wichtigste Werkzeug zur Verbrechensbekämpfung. Ständig reißende Arbeiterhosen führen zur Erfindung von Kunststoff. Ein zufälliges Gespräch und ein Wurstgift verändern das Gesicht Hollywoods für immer. Und ein kaputtes Thermometer setzt eine Kette von Ereignissen in Gang, die ein Land vom Kolonialismus befreien.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Durch ungeschicktes Hantieren landet eine Probe auf einem Herd, was zur Entdeckung von vulkanisiertem Gummi führt. Ein Griff nach dem falschen Widerstand beschert uns den Herzschrittmacher. Ein fehlgeschlagenes Experiment führt zu einer sicheren Methode zur Erzeugung von Flammen. Und die Suche nach neuen Galaxien könnte uns mit Außerirdischen in Kontakt bringen.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Die Dämpfe eines zerbrochenen Thermometers führen zur Erfindung der Fotografie. Radarteile und ein schmelzender Schokoriegel besiegeln den Siegeszug der Mikrowelle. Und als ein potenzielles Herzmedikament in Studien getestet wird, stellt man fest, dass es auf ein anderes Organ viel stärker wirkt. Später wird es unter dem Namen Viagra bekannt.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Stefan Frey ist Tauchmeister, Unterwasserschweißer und Kapitän in einem. Der Hamburger ist überall dort in Norddeutschland anzutreffen, wo unter Wasser gebaut werden muss. Brenn- und Schweißarbeiten, bohren, oder Pfähle austauschen, sind die Aufgaben der Profitaucher. Koordiniert werden ihre Einsätze, bei denen sie meistens utner Zeitdruck stehen, vom Schiffsführer über Funk.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Mit extrem hohen Temperaturen müssen Metallgießer fertig werden. Ihre Aufgabe ist es, aus flüssigem Metall harte Formen zu machen, sei es für den Maschinenbau oder die Autoindustrie. Sorgfalt und Konzentration sind hier immer das oberste Gebot. Wie sind die Schutzanzüge aufgebaut? Wie ertragen die Augen Hitze und Helligkeit und was fasziniert die Männer so sehr an diesem Beruf?

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Höhenangst dürfen Windkraft-Servicetechniker eher nicht haben. Dies ist der Arbeitsplatz der Techniker von Siemens Gamesa, einem spanischen Windkraft-Erzeuger. Weder bei der Wartung noch der Reparatur dürfen sie schwache Nerven oder Höhenangst haben, denn wo sie arbeiten, hilft ihnen kein Gerüst. Die seilgestützte Höhenarbeit spart den Auftraggebern viel Geld.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Auch unter Zeitdruck darf man nicht die Konzentration verlieren. Straßenbau-Projektleiter Heiko Schmidt weiß, dass seine Männer unter Zeitdruck stehen, denn die wichtige Hauptstadtverkehrsader soll so schnell wie möglich wieder befahrbar sein. Dennoch muss die Qualität stimmen. Die Männer müssen mit Lärm, Wetter und Staub fertig werden.

programme.title: The Price of Fame
programme.desc: In the streets of Atlanta, Cassie, a struggling young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, a charismatic interviewer who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her cunning best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry. But as hidden agendas and betrayals emerge, Cassie finds herself questioning the cost of her dreams.

programme.title: Swing
programme.desc: In the gritty streets of 1945 Philadelphia, aspiring jazz musician and street hustler, Trip, dreams of a life-changing opportunity awaiting him in the vibrant world of Harlem. With three days until the audition, his journey takes an unexpected turn as he finds himself entangled in a web of corruption, vengeful gangsters, and the ominous presence of a mysterious figure.

programme.title: Body Count Bently
programme.desc: Bently has a past for being hardcore. After the murder of her father Jesse and the disappearance of "Kato," Bently hits the streets to find out who killed her father and to clear her name from all of the bodies that are being pinned on her.

programme.title: Bissonnet 2: Back on the Blade
programme.desc: A serial killer is prowling Bissonnet street in Houston, and is targeting prostitutes. Detective Wallace and Benjamin are on the case, and will stop at nothing to bring him to justice.

programme.title: Caught in a Trapp
programme.desc: The story of a young teen who was abused by his father. Following the tragic death of his parents, he grew up on the streets and is forced into a life of running from D Slug, a known drug lord, after selling drugs from his opps!

programme.title: Fist of Vengeance
programme.desc: Ciara Johnson is struggling with life after the death of her father in a local martial arts gym. To preserve her father’s legacy, Ciara is determined to win the regional Wushu Regional championship, and to keep the art alive in her father’s memory. However, she discovers a secret operation that is connected to her father’s death. Witness the showdown between legacy, and the new school of martial arts.

programme.title: Flew'd Out
programme.desc: Tiara is an up and coming social media influencer after going viral for posting a mans reaction online after denying him sex. In an attempt to grow her online profile, she accepts a date from a man named Josiah for an out of town excursion. Over time, Josiah's intentions become more elaborate, deranged, and sinister. Will Tiara make it out alive?

programme.title: The Wrong Someone
programme.desc: Tina and Phillip’s marriage is struggling and teetering on the edge of no return. When her former flame, Mike, comes back into her life. All the while, Phillip begins engaging into a flirtatious affair with her best friend Makella. Will Tina honor her marriage? Or move on to someone new.

programme.title: Black Game Night
programme.desc: A group of friends prepare to attend The Blacks’ annual game night, but make a chilling discovery when the arrive to find the hosts have been brutally murdered. In their pursuit to uncover the murderer, secrets unravel and betrayals are discovered, winning no longer becomes the goal – it’s surviving.

programme.title: Mistress for Hire
programme.desc: Skylar works as a professional mistress hired by women for divorce leverage. When she finds herself falling for her target, Eric, she questions her career and her motives. But when Eric’s wife, Octavia, won’t allow Skylar to destroy her plans, and a dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with love and survival on the line.

programme.title: To Live and Die in DC
programme.desc: Lance Hill sticks to the street code of DC and is admired by those who crave fast money, who put risk over reward. It's his turn to tell his story... If he lives.

programme.title: Murder on the Blade
programme.desc: Tobin, a young man with a troubled childhood is currently working through his trauma with a professional counselor. Meanwhile, there is a serial killer on the loose targeting sex workers, and several clues are pointing to both him and his troubled relationship with his mother.

programme.title: Bloodline Secrets
programme.desc: Thirty-three-year-old Keisha is engaged to be married to the man of her dreams, Joseph. Joseph believes he’s ready for marriage with the love of his life but his best friend, John, has his doubts about Keisha’s faithfulness. When family secrets come out of the shadows, it puts their marriage and lives in jeopardy.

programme.title: 10 Kilos in the Trunk
programme.desc: Tonya needs to make some quick cash for the holidays, and takes a job transporting cocaine. On the way to the drop-off, her car breaks down in the middle of nowhere. While walking to a gas station for help, she is stopped by a police officer, and arrested for several warrants. Now in jail, Tonya, gets her friend Monica to make the delivery. Monica must get the car fixed, avoid a thief looking to steal the product, and make the delivery by the deadline or both will face deadly consequences.

programme.title: Everything I Never Expected
programme.desc: Opposites attract when a spoiled bachelor and a broke college grad accidentally become roommates. Forced to cohabitate in a less-than-ideal apartment, they clash, prank, and eventually fall for each other. Life challenges and misunderstandings complicate their budding romance, but true love prevails.

programme.title: Toxic Affair
programme.desc: A young woman abandoned by her mother and raised by her father has a miscarriage which derails her life. In an attempt to find support, she seeks out her married sister, only to find herself in a toxic affair.

The night reaches its peak during Freestyle, where Blake Granger and Monster Mutt Dalmatian deliver a spectacular performance, including a signature backflip, to sweep the competition. After a fierce battle against top competitors like Matt Cody in Grave Digger, Blake Granger is crowned the BKT Overall Event Champion.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Frank Slopianka é altamente ambicioso e comprometido com o evento de corridas de arrasto 'Race@Airport'. O concessionário americano de carros de Berlim leva cerca de onze segundos para terminar o quarto de milha com seu Camaro de 700 hp. A empresa de afinação Mansory promete aceleração adicional e potência a cavalo para os carros Lamborghini. Um bom exemplo é o Mansory Carbonado, um Aventador Convertível reconstruído.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Não há melhor lugar para experimentar o fascínio da velocidade do que em Nürburgring. É a pista de corrida mais perigosa, porém a mais bonita do mundo e ponto de encontro de ícones e raridades das corridas. O Sport1 Track Day anual atrai milhares de cabeças de gasolina para Nürburgring, onde eles podem participar da corrida de dragster de 1/8 milhas ou do evento 'Rolling 50'.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Todos os anos, o estilo único da cena ciclista na Califórnia é uma inspiração sem igual para Ola Stenegard, Chefe de Design de Veículos da BMW Motorrad. Em Los Angeles ele conhece personalizadores mundialmente famosos como Michael 'Wooley' Woolaway e Alan Stulberg. Além disso: MOTORVISION TV - #SPOTTED apresenta os mais loucos 'super-carros caseiros' como o Fahrradi Farfalla FFX, o carro esportivo mais lento do mundo.

programme.title: Lancia Stratos HF
programme.desc: O Lancia Stratos com potência Ferrari, o ícone do rally dos anos 70.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupe
programme.desc: O M6 Gran Coupe é a última criação da subdivisão M-works da BMW. Os bávaros mostram que dirigir este carro V8 quase parece voar, mesmo com toda a família a bordo.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia da BMW
programme.desc: Prazer de dirigir: A BMW, um dos grupos automotivos de maior sucesso do mundo, promete exatamente isso. Os carros e motos esportivos da Bavarian Motorenwerke AG são igualmente populares entre os clientes e nos esportes de corrida.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: É o Porsche "James Dean", a Spyder 550. É pequeno, plano e rápido. E foi construído apenas 140 vezes. Mas mesmo assim, a aranha Porsche 550 escreve a história. E é o carro em que a lenda de Hollywood, James Dean, morre em um acidente. A História Automotiva conta toda a história do carro dos sonhos dos anos 50.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Seja em Rallye, Circuito ou Indianápolis. Por mais de 100 anos, as corridas têm sido a força motriz da Ford. Os heróis daquela época são agora lendas.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: A BMW é um dos fabricantes de automóveis de maior sucesso no mundo. Desde o início, as corridas têm sido um dos principais componentes. E a transferência de tecnologia é uma grande vantagem, especialmente para os clientes.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Nos anos 80 e 90, a Porsche corre de vitória em vitória. Uma McLaren vence três vezes a Copa do Mundo de Fórmula 1 com a Porsche power. A Porsche de 1982 começa uma série de vitórias em Le Mans. As décadas de 1980, 1990 e 2000 são os anos dourados do automobilismo para a Porsche. A História Automotiva mostra os carros mais rápidos, as corridas mais emocionantes e os pilotos mais famosos.

programme.title: Glas 1700 GT
programme.desc: O Glas GT parece uma Ferrari, mas vem da província da Baixa Baviera, na Alemanha. No início dos anos 60, era um dos poucos carros esportivos alemães.

programme.title: Peugeot 205 Turbo 16
programme.desc: A Peugeot lançou este clássico, todo monstro de tração nas rodas com um único propósito: deveria trazer o Campeonato Mundial de Rally para a França. O Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 sacudiu o mundo do rali nos anos 80.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Days of Thunder - um evento de 1/8 milhas onde todos podem testar a velocidade do seu carro ou motocicleta. Mas atingimos o local com um BMW X6 M de Haman com mais de 600 cv.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Já na oitava temporada da German Race Wars, visitantes de mais de 20 países fazem uma peregrinação ao mega-evento. E: O Mini John Cooper Works é a versão de corrida do piloto bávaro. Arden o transforma no Arden Mini AM 3.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Para a BMW tuner Manhart Racing, o Nürburgring Nordschleife é o lugar ideal para comemorar seu 25º aniversário. Como parte dos Track Days, clientes e partes interessadas têm a oportunidade de conhecer os modelos Manhart.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Uma vez por ano, os fãs de afinação de carros de todo o país se encontram no Neue Messe Dresden para o XS Carnight. Em 35.000 metros quadrados há sonhos de carros a serem vistos aqui enquanto as luzes se apagam do lado de fora.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Ao contrário das inúmeras reuniões do carro Show & Shine, no Rust'n'Roll quanto mais velho melhor. Somente quando os veículos parecem realmente velhos e enferrujados, são considerados bonitos.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: A NitrolympX é um evento esportivo motorizado que foi realizado pela primeira vez em Hockenheim, em 1986. Com cerca de 30.000 espectadores e cerca de 300 participantes, é o maior evento internacional de drag race da Europa.

programme.title: Um Fusca afinado!
programme.desc: Parece um Volkswagen Fusca dos anos setenta. Mas com afinação contemporânea, potência de 90 cavalos e velocidade máxima de 112 mph, promete prazer de dirigir sem limites.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Os novos descapotáveis e a luz do sol pertencem apenas um ao outro. Nós testamos os novos descapotáveis da série 6 da BMW na Table Mountain, na África do Sul.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: A Audi construiu 333 unidades de seu modelo GT, e a mudança de marcha do carro mostra três zeros. O motorista de testes Patrick tentará descobrir do que se trata e ver o que 560 HP podem fazer na condução diária.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Hoje se trata de um peso leve no segmento de classe alta alemã, o Audi A6 2.0 TDI. Mais eficiência, menos peso e mais esportividade é o que o fabricante promove para vencer a corrida contra a BMW e a Mercedes.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Colocamos à prova os 555 HP do Wiesmann MF5 no hipódromo de Spa-Francochamps, nas Ardenas Belgas. Um projeto excepcional de carro esportivo, 8 cilindros, motor bi-turbo. Ele pode competir com Ferrari ou Porsche?

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: A corrida de 24 horas no Nürburgring é considerada a corrida de longa distância mais difícil nos esportes motorizados. A Volkswagen colocou a si mesma este desafio com um carro realmente especial.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: O Mercedes SL65 AMG é o último modelo alemão de carro de força em um terno feito sob medida.

programme.title: Jaguar D-Type
programme.desc: O grande vencedor nas 24 horas de Le Mans. O Jaguar D-Type ganhou a prova de enduro mais dura do mundo três vezes seguidas.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nos anos 70, os modelos W 114/115 da Mercedes ofereciam engenharia sólida a preços moderados, o que fez com que o sedan com estilo Paul Braq se tornasse o primeiro Mercedes para pessoas comuns. Também: um inconspícuo Volkswagen Beetle de 1972 com 90 cv que atingiu 180 km/h na Autobahn. E: um marco na história automotiva da época: o NSU RO 80 com um motor rotativo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nos anos 50, o Tatra da Tchecoslováquia introduziu carros avançados, até mesmo pioneiros. A clientela era exclusiva, e é por isso que estes carros são muito raros hoje em dia. Encontramos o proprietário de um Tatra T87 de 1937.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Porsche 911 Targa, com sua construção leve, é um carro icônico. Além disso: o Lotus Seven Twin Cam SS é mais um carro de corrida do que um carro de estrada. E: o Bentley Blower de 1930 e o Sunbeam Tiger Roadster.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O GTA da Ford Fairlane de 1967 na forma NASCAR. Além disso: O Chrysler 300 C de 1995 era o veículo de produção mais potente dos Estados Unidos. E: o Cadillac série 62 conversível de 1949 estabelece novos padrões em luxo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Triumph 1800 Roadster de 1947 oferece espaço para 5 entusiastas do ar fresco. Mais: The Jog, o rally de carros clássico mais difícil da Europa. E: o Wolseley Stellite de 1919.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: No final dos anos 50, a Facel Vega Facellia foi projetada para competir com a Porsche e a Alfa Romeo e abrir um novo segmento de mercado para a jovem empresa francesa de carros de luxo.

programme.title: BMW M3 Test Drive - A BMW de maior sucesso de todos os tempos!
programme.desc: Nos anos 80, a BMW lançou um carro que tinha verdadeiros genes de corrida, o M3. Originalmente concebido como modelo de homologação para o Campeonato Alemão de Carros de Turismo, tornou-se num dos carros desportivos de estrada mais quentes do mundo.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: A McLaren é uma das marcas de automóveis mais famosas da Grã-Bretanha. Quase não há carros esportivos que fascinem tanto quanto uma McLaren ou que tenham uma herança tão lendária no automobilismo. Dois modelos recentes da McLaren são o 650S e a série limitada P1. Os supercarros estão com vontade de amar e namorar o 650S da McLaren em uma antiga área industrial e na pista de corrida.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Há detalhes que diferenciam os super carros dos carros normais e estes detalhes são essenciais. Os super carros são os maiores, mais barulhentos e mais caros da rodovia; são obras de arte de quatro rodas.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: La Dolce Vita - 100 Anos de Maserati
programme.desc: Em comemoração a seu centenário, a Maserati se premiou com um belo cupê chamado Maserati Alfiere. Mas isso não é tudo. A empresa convida para uma viagem de Bolonha a Turim com os mais belos modelos das últimas décadas. Os supercarros participam desta viagem com um Granturismo MC Stradale.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O seu nome é Mulsanne, Bentely Mulsanne. O novo carro-chefe da Bentley atinge uma velocidade máxima de cerca de 300 km/h, é luxuoso como um hotel de primeira classe e elegante como um terno Armani. Os supercarros revelam como é andar num carro de sonho como este. E mais: os supercarros dão uma olhada no notável Rolls Royce Ghost e no coupé de alta tecnologia Mercedes S 63 AMG.

programme.title: Volvo XC60 - O sueco cool
programme.desc: A paisagem sueca é caracterizada por montanhas, florestas e estradas solitárias. Ideal para este off-roader. O Volvo XC60 pontua com muitas características de segurança e uma aparência fresca.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: No Grand Prix dos veteranos em Nürburgring, por exemplo, você pode ver o Mercedes S com 160 cavalos de potência que levou Rudolf Caracciola à vitória na corrida de abertura de 1927.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Neste episódio, nos concentramos na Phoenix Racing, a equipe de sucesso da Região Eifel que abalou o DTM.

programme.title: Trackmasters

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Visitantes de todo o mundo se dirigem ao Inferno Verde de Nürburgring todos os anos, incluindo muitos alemães, austríacos e 5 ingleses loucos em um táxi.

programme.desc: Os carros maníacos são convidados a trazer os seus veículos afinados para "The Walk" na Praia de Jumeirah para serem julgados em termos de velocidade, estilo e som. Neste episódio, um Chevrolet Camaro e um Mercedes SLS AMG tentarão uau.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: Com a Bentley Bentayga, a tradicional marca britânica está entrando no segmento de mercado que mais cresce. Este primeiro SUV de luxo do mundo é um conglomerado de superlativos sobre rodas.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018
programme.desc: O Mercedes Sprinter pertence à classe dos veículos comerciais. O transportador leve é o sonho de todo negociante. A terceira geração do Sprinter é mais elegante, mais moderna e mais variável do que nunca.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia do carro - Land Rover
programme.desc: Robusto, honesto, simples, o Land Rover é o alicerce dos veículos off-road. Construído em 1948 como um simples carro para os agricultores britânicos, o Land Rover logo se tornou um sucesso de exportação. Hoje, o Landy está em casa em todo o mundo, um carro em qualquer lugar, um todo-o-terreno e um todo-terreno.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Vive la diferença: sempre extraordinário no design, sempre incomum no conforto do motor, muitas vezes de vanguarda: os carros da marca Renault. Com o Dauphine, os modelos R4, R16 e R5, a Renault está fazendo história.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Estes são carros com paixão. Desde o início, a Citroën celebrou a alegria da extravagância. Um marco na história automotiva é a Traction Avant, chamada de gangster sedan. O 2 CVS chamado "o pato" é incomum e encantador. O pato se torna um veículo de culto para estudantes, professores e mestres na arte de viver. O DS19, a deusa, parece que veio de outra estrela.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: É o carro da razão, não excitante, mas um mega-vendedor: o VW Golf, o carro de maior sucesso da Europa, 30 milhões de unidades vendidas. O Golfe é compatível com a massa, sem classe e domina a classe compacta. A história do carro mostra a história da geração Golf e revela o segredo de seu sucesso.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Ninguém é mais rápido, ninguém é mais confiável e ninguém é mais bem-sucedido do que a Porsche Racing. Com mais de 28.000 vitórias em 65 anos, a Porsche estabeleceu um recorde mundial. A História Automotiva conta a história das imbatíveis equipes de corrida de Zuffenhausen. A lenda do rally Walter Röhrl e o vencedor do Le Mans Hans Hermann também comentam sobre o sucesso da Porsche Racing.

Matilde y Moncho ven cumplidos sus deseos al ser enviados por Marco Aurelio a las obras de Nirgua y all verse en el dilema de ser infieles a sus parejas o no, debido a la atracci n mutua que ambos sienten. programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 162: El Temor de Egl e y Secretos
programme.desc: Egl e se deja invadir por el temor de incluso llegar a perder la vida por causa de la palpable existencia de un n dulo en su seno, sinti ndose preocupada por el echo de llegar a dejar de existir para su familia, Lu s Fernando y Cristina no ayudan a que Egl e haga mas llevadera su preocupaci n al insistir en discutir por tonter as y hacer una batalla campal de la nada. Tras recibir la visita de sus padres, Betzaida habla maravillas del comportamiento de R mulo para con ella y su reci n nacida hija. Al sentirse sumamente preocupada por su hallazgo, y sin quererlo Egl e interviene en la vida familiar de R mulo y Betzaida al requerir la ayuda de su ex esposo para informarlo de su temor al creerse padeciendo de c ncer de mama. Cumpliendo el presagio de Gladys, Gerson llega a su casa para saber la verdad de la paternidad de Paco por boca de su propia madre. A pesar de los reclamos de su nueva esposa Betzaida R mulo decide mantener en secreto la situaci n de Egl e al tambi n sentirse preocupado de llegar a perder a la madre de sus hijos. Ante los lamentos sin sentido de Pascuita Gladys en actitud ir nica toma con ligereza sus propios problemas. Matilde y Moncho ven cumplidos sus deseos al ser enviados por Marco Aurelio a las obras de Nirgua y all verse en el dilema de ser infieles a sus parejas o no, debido a la atracci n mutua que ambos sienten. Entre tanto con el mayor descaro, Yenil y Gonzalo coquetean en presencia de todos en la oficina, vi ndose obligados a disimular ante la presencia de Matilde quien le informa a su esposo sobre su repentino viaje a Nirgua no sin antes suscitar una peque a discusi n entre ambos que tambi n les recuerda la actitud de tolerancia y paciencia que ambos se comprometieron a tener para llevar a cabo su supuesta reconciliaci n. Pascuita con su comentario minimiza las preocupaciones y la vida diaria de Gladys al ella creer sus problemas como los mas importantes y dif ciles de resolver debido a echo de tener marido y estar al pendiente de las actividades de este para no darle en ning n momento el chance de serle infiel tras descubrirlo interesado por Matilde, Moncho llama a su esposa para informarla de su precipitado viaje logrando con dicha situaci n causarle un desmayo tras alertarla que su acompa ante en dicho viaje ser Matilde. Al percatarse del desmayo de Pascuita Gladys se encarga de tomar el tel fono para explicarle a Moncho lo sucedido y proseguir inmediatamente a devolverle el tel fono a su patrona al verla ya reestablecida, Matilde disimulando su furia ante su esposo se asegura de que este volver el mismo d a a su casa al verse obligada a padecer el temor de que Matilde y este duerman juntos. En su consulta con Ed n Felicita informa a su medico psiquiatra de lo acontecido en sus sentimientos tras su ruptura con Aureliano situaci n que provoco su falta de animo para propiciar su accidente. programme.title: A Possessão de Mary
programme.desc: David (Gary Oldman) é um capitão de colarinho azul que luta para melhorar a vida de sua família. Estranhamente atraído por um navio abandonado que está em leilão, David impulsivamente compra o barco, acreditando que será o bilhete de sua família para a felicidade e a prosperidade. Mas logo depois que eles embarcam em sua jornada inaugural, eventos estranhos e assustadores começam a aterrorizar David e sua família, fazendo com que se voltem um contra o outro e duvidem de sua própria sanidade.

programme.title: Do Outro Lado do Corredor
programme.desc: Acreditando que June (Brittany Murphy), sua noiva, está sendo infiel, Terry (Danny Pino) decide segui-la por toda a cidade. Ao descobrir a traição, ele decide matar a mulher. Hospedado no mesmo hotel em que ela está com o amante, Terry liga para o amigo Julian (Mike Vogel), que tentará impedir que Terry cometa um crime.

Uma exploração emocionante da identidade, legado e pertencimento africanos - a história gira em torno de Jacob Makhubu, filho de mãe sul-africana e pai nigeriano - um alto executivo de uma empresa petrolífera de propriedade nigeriana com sede em Joanesburgo.

programme.title: La Hermana Buena
programme.desc: Fontayne es reclutada por Bernice (su vieja amiga distanciada y actual oficial de libertad condicional) junto con un policía deshonrado para buscar al hijo de Bernice, que desapareció en la frontera con México.

programme.title: A Hora do Acerto
programme.desc: Para a Gangue dos 5, tudo é um videogame: matar policiais, armar emboscadas e criar requintes de crueldade. Quem se torna vítima de suas armadilhas é o inspetor de polícia Wing e todo o seu time de policiais, que são brutalmente assassinados. Após a matança, um jovem novato cheio de energia é designado para ajudálo, mas a Gangue dos 5 volta a agir, iniciando uma aventura cheia de ação e vingança.

programme.title: Secretos Peligrosos
programme.desc: Un drama basado en las experiencias de Kathryn Bolkovac, una policía de Nebraska que sirvió como fuerza de paz en la Bosnia de posguerra y denunció a la ONU por encubrir un escándalo de tráfico sexual.

programme.title: Olhos de Dragão
programme.desc: Em St. Jude, traficantes de drogas e policiais corruptos destruíram um bairro urbano. Mas o recém-chegado Hong possui as habilidades de luta e a visão moral necessárias para salvar esta cidade de si mesma.

programme.title: O Dono do Jogo
programme.desc: A história dos preparativos para o lendário confronto pelo campeonato mundial entre Bobby Fischer, o campeão americano de xadrez, e o campeão soviético Boris Spassky. O duelo, que ocorreu em 1972, no auge da Guerra Fria, foi muito mais do que apenas uma série de partidas para conquistar um campeonato.

programme.title: A Vilã
programme.desc: Desde pequena, Sook-hee foi treinada para se tornar uma assassina. Quando é recrutada como agente secreta, ela tem uma nova oportunidade de trabalhar por 10 anos e ganhar sua liberdade. Sua nova identidade é ser atriz de teatro. Para alguém que viveu uma vida de assassinatos, levar uma vida normal não é fácil. Mas logo eles descobrirão os segredos de seu passado.

programme.title: Frank & Penelope
programme.desc: Um conto de amor e violência, um homem com seus conflitos emocionais, encontra sua salvadora e alma gêmea, Penelope, dançando sedutoramente em um clube de strip em ruínas. E uma vida que certamente caiu de um penhasco de repente é redirecionada. Agora TUDO vale a pena. Até morrer.

programme.title: Código da Máfia
programme.desc: Mike acaba de sair da prisão e aceita fazer um último serviço com seu irmão para poder se livrar do mundo do crime e cuidar de sua filha. Ele logo descobrirá que a justiça das ruas é muito pior que tudo o que passou na prisão.

programme.title: Departamento Q: Guardiões das Causas Perdidas
programme.desc: Após um tiroteio que deixou um de seus parceiros morto e outro paralítico, o detetive Carl é designado para o Departamento Q, um novo departamento para casos antigos e arquivados, composto apenas por ele e seu assistente.

programme.title: Codinome Cassius 7
programme.desc: Um agente aposentado da CIA se une a um agente do FBI para desvendar o mistério do assassinato de um senador.

programme.title: O Justiceiro
programme.desc: Mestre em artes marciais e lutador, Kung Wei, vive numa casa humilde, com a esposa que está muito doente e com Johnny, seu filho que o adora e segue seus ensinamentos morais e de artes marciais. Kung Wei, é "recrutado" sigilosamente pela polícia, para disfarçado, desmantelar uma quadrilha em Hong Kong. Enquanto trabalhava com outra identidade, seu filho sofria com seus colegas que chamavam o pai de "bandido"; pois, a ele imputavam um crime. Neste meio tempo, sua esposa morre. Antes de morrer, ela confia a guarda do pequeno Johnny, ao policial que "investigava" Kung, supondo que se marido fosse um bandido perigoso. O mestre Kung Wei, terá que lutar muito nessa missão!

programme.title: End Game: Roubo de Identidade
programme.desc: Um é um assassino implacável, o outro é um ator desconhecido. Uma súbita reviravolta do destino, tarde demais para voltar atrás. Duas vidas trocadas os trouxeram para uma vida milagrosa!

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.desc: In this modern adaptation of Jane Austen’s Sense and Sensibility, Elinor and Marianne find themselves penniless after their father’s fortune is taken away. As they look for ways to pay the bills, they encounter people who judge them and try to keep them down in the dumps. Add falling in love into the mix, and determining whom to trust becomes a mine field. Can the sisters find a balance between relying on their hearts and using good sense without losing everything they hold dear?

programme.title: Retreat to Paradise
programme.desc: Ellie tends to the injured and cantankerous Jordan as he heals from a shoulder injury. Though he struggles to learn to use his arm again, his attitude leaves Ellie wanting to leave him in his misery. But as they get to know each other more, Jordan starts to see Ellie is exactly who he wants in his life, and hopes Ellie feels the same way.

programme.title: Love in Focus
programme.desc: When the hit show actress Jenna Wilde stars in suddenly gets cancelled, the press start circling. To escape the chaos Jenna retreats to a snowy cabin in the mountains. Unexpectedly, she must share this peaceful place with a rude and rugged nature photographer Chris Dixon. Their coolness towards each other starts to thaw when Chris helps Jenna audition for other shows.

programme.title: A Heart Apart
programme.desc: A quick spreading virus has shut down the world. But when Kenzie and Chase connect in the unlikeliest of ways, they are faced with a perplexing question: how does dating work when you have to stay six feet apart?

programme.title: Romance on the Ranch
programme.desc: When her truck breaks down in the mid-west, Sara is invited to park her camper on a family ranch while her truck is repaired. She meets two brothers, who are as different as night and day. The brothers are instantly smitten with Sara and soon she begins to have feelings for them both. The last thing Sara expected to find was romance on the ranch.

programme.title: Love’s Portrait
programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: Seeking Persephone
programme.desc: To save her destitute family, Persephone Lancaster accepts a marriage proposal from Adam Boyce, the mysterious Duke of Kielder, the most feared man in the kingdom. Isolated in the duke’s foreboding castle, Persephone searches for what happiness she can find. But Adam’s determination to keep his new bride at a distance makes a future between them precarious.

programme.title: Seeking Persephone
programme.desc: Though Adam is still confusing and distant, glimpses of the good man behind the frightening facade give Persephone some hope for their future. Word arrives of a deadly battle at sea, bringing Persephone’s world crashing down around her. Adam is at a loss to know how to ease her suffering. He is called away on an urgent rescue mission. Their brief time apart lays bare the attachment that is growing between them.

programme.title: Identical Love
programme.desc: After being left at the altar, Dr. Charlotte Hudson needs to escape life at home. She signs up to volunteer at a health clinic in a tropical country. But her plans of escaping are thrown off when she comes across her former fiancé’s twin brother, Seth (a dentist), who is also volunteering with the clinic. As they spend time together, Seth falls in love with Charlotte, but she struggles to let go of seeing her fiancé every time she looks at Seth. The island romance will help her break free from the past and love Seth for who he is.

programme.desc: Two tourists in Turkey get left behind by their tour bus after visiting an archaeological site. Without their belongings, they must make their way back to Istanbul, improvising along the way with meager means.

Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: Seeking Persephone
programme.desc: To save her destitute family, Persephone Lancaster accepts a marriage proposal from Adam Boyce, the mysterious Duke of Kielder, the most feared man in the kingdom. Isolated in the duke’s foreboding castle, Persephone searches for what happiness she can find. But Adam’s determination to keep his new bride at a distance makes a future between them precarious.

programme.title: Seeking Persephone
programme.desc: Though Adam is still confusing and distant, glimpses of the good man behind the frightening facade give Persephone some hope for their future. Word arrives of a deadly battle at sea, bringing Persephone’s world crashing down around her. Adam is at a loss to know how to ease her suffering. He is called away on an urgent rescue mission. Their brief time apart lays bare the attachment that is growing between them.

programme.title: Identical Love
programme.desc: After being left at the altar, Dr. Charlotte Hudson needs to escape life at home. She signs up to volunteer at a health clinic in a tropical country. But her plans of escaping are thrown off when she comes across her former fiancé’s twin brother, Seth (a dentist), who is also volunteering with the clinic. As they spend time together, Seth falls in love with Charlotte, but she struggles to let go of seeing her fiancé every time she looks at Seth. The island romance will help her break free from the past and love Seth for who he is.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the early 1900s, race tracks built of wood sprang up across the country drawing crowds of 50,000 and more. Ray and Xtreme sports superstar Travis Pastrana break down the Battle on the Boards.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds a Gurney Eagle in a garage on Long Island. He wants to put the coveted machine back on the track at Indy to honor Dan Gurney. After intense restoration and scouring the globe for a Gurney-Westlake engine, the Eagle soars again.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Dale Earnhardt Jr. wants Ray to help restore an El Camino, except add on a Laguna front end. It’s not a typical restoration, but it’s certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the secrets of America’s greatest racing sport in the foothills of North Carolina. When moonshiners were looking to outrun police officers, they would custom fit engines to race the back woods tracks. That sport eventually evolved into NASCAR and Ray talks to the early adopters of this national pastime.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: Em “O Som da Música”, Jacarelvis e seus amigos apresentam as características e sons de diversos instrumentos musicais pertencentes a diferentes culturas. Cada episódio é dedicado a algum instrumento específico, onde são apresentados brevemente a história, os atributos e funcionamento de instrumentos como o violão, o xilofone, a gaita, piano, flauta, entre outros. E a festa sonora fica por conta de Jacarelvis e seus amigos, que apresentam as suas habilidades musicais com cada um dos instrumentos.

Desafios de atenção e curiosidades tornam essa série divertida e educativa, ensinando o conceito de desenho por meio de formas geométricas. Divirta-se e aprenda com o Mago das Formas!

programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.sub-title: FishON | Spring Thaw on Frederick House Lake
programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

Guided by the rising sun, we gear up with our Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake for a day filled with fishing action and good times. Joining the adventure is Mercury Canada Marketing Manager Cameron Racine, adding expertise and excitement to this unforgettable outing. Don't miss the fun, the fish, and the breathtaking scenery!
